flows:
Navigate to https://www.patagonia.com/home/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it."
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First, press Tab twice in the page before evaluating focusability.
Continue using Tab and Shift+Tab to reach the target.
check a primary Shop Now or category CTA on the Patagonia homepage is in sequential keyboard focus order.
Activate it with Tab and Enter and verify a product collection page loads.
Stop before cart or checkout.

remark: wait: Waiting while the Patagonia homepage maintenance message remains visible

summary:

Retry after maintenance ends, or add a preflight check that recognizes the maintenance page and reports the run as unavailable before asserting that a Shop Now or category CTA exists.
